LESSON: SIGN READING 7.2.1 EXTENSIVE READING AND SIGN READING: NARRATIVES/POEMS

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade four
Subject: General
Strand: Strand 7
Topic 7.2: Sign Reading 7.2.1 Extensive Reading and sign reading: Narratives/Poems
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Sign Reading 7.2.1 Extensive Reading and sign reading: Narratives/Poems, part of Strand 7 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade four General.

Key inquiry question: Why should we read different types of materials?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Sign Reading 7.2.1 Extensive Reading and sign reading: Narratives/Poems together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Communication and collaboration: team work as learners exchange ideas during school reading clubs.

● Learning to learn: learning independently as learner work on their own to source information from graded readers.

60

Values:
● Respect: open mindedness is developed as the learner appreciates opinions of others when sharing reflections on the text.

● Unity: inclusion is nurtured as learner is guided to set up an after-school club where they meet on a regular basis to read extensively.

Link to other subjects:

The learner is able to relate the theme to learning Science and Technology.
